properties.name: A whole corpus of existing specifications can be brought into the design in one pass
properties.statement: Where a system's intent already exists as a large body of written specifications, reflow2 must be able to take the whole corpus — a folder, not a file — and produce one coherent design from it, with every claim still pointing back at the document it came from. The load-bearing requirement is identity ACROSS documents: the same component named in forty specifications must converge on one node rather than forty near-duplicates, and where convergence is uncertain the user is asked rather than the nodes being silently merged. Ordering must not decide meaning — which file happened to be read first must not determine the canonical name of anything.
